rows.text: Kotis is Voltron where the reward is other people's cards. He exiles cards off the defending player equal to the DAMAGE he dealt, and you cast any number of them for free as long as they cost that much or less. So every point of power you add does two jobs — it kills faster and it digs deeper. And because he is indestructible, the most dangerous pump effects in the format cost him nothing.

rows.name: Kotis, the Fangkeeper
rows.text: indestructible, and every connection exiles X cards and casts any number of them with mana value X or less, free. A ten-damage hit routinely produces two or three free spells.

rows.name: Berserk
rows.text: doubles his power and grants trample for one green mana. The "destroy it at end of turn" clause is a dead line of text on an indestructible creature. This is the single best card in the deck.

rows.name: Inquisitor's Flail
rows.text: doubles his combat damage. The drawback — he takes double damage back — does not matter, because he cannot be destroyed.

rows.name: Leyline Axe
rows.text: double strike, so Kotis triggers TWICE, each with its own X. It can start the game on the battlefield if it is in your opening hand.

rows.name: Fireshrieker
rows.text: gives double strike, ensuring two distinct Kotis combat damage triggers per swing.

rows.name: Felix Five-Boots
rows.text: combat damage triggers of your permanents happen an additional time. Two full Kotis triggers per connection.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: name Zombie or Warrior. Another doubling of the same trigger.

rows.name: Brotherhood Regalia
rows.text: equip to a legendary creature for {1} — ward {2} and completely unblockable. The cheapest enabler in the deck.

rows.name: My Precious
rows.text: hexproof and unblockable on one Equipment, and the Adventure half draws two.

rows.name: Aqueous Form
rows.text: one mana, unblockable, and it scries every attack.

rows.name: Security Bypass
rows.text: unblockable while attacking alone, plus a connive on every hit.

rows.name: Distortion Strike
rows.text: grants +1/+0 and unblockable this turn, then rebounds from exile on your next upkeep for a second free unblockable attack.

rows.name: Shadowspear
rows.text: grants trample and lifelink to buffer your life while punching through, and removes hexproof or indestructible from opposing blockers.

rows.name: Rogue's Passage
rows.text: an unblockable engine stapled to an untapped utility land when opponents hold up creature removal.

rows.name: Conqueror's Flail
rows.text: opponents cannot cast spells during your turn while it is attached. Deploy it before the big swing.

rows.name: Might of the Nephilim
rows.text: Kotis is Sultai (black, green, and blue), so this gives him a staggering +6/+6 for just two mana. Combined with Berserk or double strike, it creates game-ending damage.

rows.name: Invigorate
rows.text: +4/+4 for free by giving an opponent 3 life. A zero-mana pump that can be cast before damage to steal larger cards or close a lethal window.

rows.name: Tainted Strike
rows.text: gives +1/+0 and infect at instant speed for {B}. At 10 power Kotis eliminates a player instantly while still exiling 10 cards.

rows.name: Blackblade Reforged
rows.text: +1/+1 per land. On turn seven that is +7/+7 for a three-mana equip on a legendary creature.

rows.name: Strong Back
rows.text: +2/+2 for every Aura and Equipment attached, and it makes every subsequent Aura and Equipment cost three less. It is both a payoff and a discount.

rows.name: Bear Umbra
rows.text: +2/+2, untaps all your lands when he attacks — so the free spells you just exiled can be followed by ones you pay for — and umbra armor eats a removal spell.

rows.name: Rancor
rows.text: +2/+0 and trample for one mana, and it returns to your hand when it dies.

rows.name: Overprotect
rows.text: +3/+3, trample, hexproof and indestructible at instant speed.

rows.name: Spellseeker -> Berserk
rows.text: when Kotis is unblocked and you need double damage and trample to close the game or exile deep into their deck.

rows.name: Spellseeker -> Might of the Nephilim
rows.text: when you need raw stats (+6/+6) to pump Kotis before damage.

rows.name: Spellseeker -> Tainted Strike
rows.text: the surprise one-shot infect kill line.

rows.name: Spellseeker -> Heroic Intervention
rows.text: when you need to protect your board from a wipe.

rows.name: Spellseeker -> Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: tutors an overloaded wipe to clear all blockers.

rows.name: Grim Tutor
rows.text: unconditional tutor for three mana to assemble whatever piece of the unblockable/pump equation is missing.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: grants protection from everything until your next turn, buys an extra turn to swing, and draws deep into pump and counterspells.

rows.name: Gonti, Night Minister
rows.text: a Treasure whenever anyone casts a spell they do not own, and it exiles a card off an opponent whenever any creature damages them.

rows.name: Dauthi Voidwalker
rows.text: unblockable, exiles everything headed for their graveyards, and cashes in for a free cast.

rows.name: Guardian Augmenter
rows.text: your commander gets +2/+2 and HEXPROOF. Flash, so it can arrive in response to removal.

rows.name: Slip Out the Back
rows.text: one mana, phases him out with everything attached.

rows.name: Legolas's Quick Reflexes
rows.text: split second, so nothing can respond at all.

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: hexproof and indestructible for the whole board.

rows.name: Glen Elendra Archmage
rows.text: a repeatable counterspell for the removal spell that matters, twice thanks to persist.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: counter their answer, then spend the mana equipping.

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: one mana for an instant, sorcery, or enchantment answer.

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: the same for anything noncreature.

rows.name: Assassin's Trophy
rows.text: two mana for any permanent.

rows.name: Reality Shift
rows.text: exile a blocker and leave them a 2/2 they cannot use.

rows.name: Damnation
rows.text: a wrath, and Kotis walks away from it untouched.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: overloaded, it clears every blocker for the lethal swing.

rows.name: Manglehorn
rows.text: an artifact destroyed on entry, and their artifacts arrive tapped.

rows.name: Tishana's Tidebinder
rows.text: shuts down activated and triggered abilities on troublesome permanents.

rows.name: Veil of Summer
rows.text: stops blue and black interaction dead.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: turn-one fixing.

rows.name: Bloom Tender
rows.text: three colours off one tap once Kotis is out.

rows.name: Delighted Halfling
rows.text: uncounterable mana for legendary spells, which is Kotis and most of the Equipment.

rows.name: Deathrite Shaman
rows.text: mana, drain and lifegain from one card.

rows.name: Nature's Lore
rows.text: an untapped dual.

rows.name: Farseek
rows.text: the same for shocklands.

rows.name: Three Visits
rows.text: copies Nature's Lore for redundant early ramp.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: their turns pay for yours.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: the strongest card in the deck on turns one through four.

rows.name: Combat Research
rows.text: a card on every hit, plus +1/+1 and ward on a legendary creature.

rows.name: Toski, Bearer of Secrets
rows.text: uncounterable, indestructible card draw engine that triggers on every combat connection.

rows.name: Eternal Witness
rows.text: any card back from the graveyard.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep an unblockable enabler and early ramp. Aqueous Form, Brotherhood Regalia, Security Bypass, or Distortion Strike is what turns Kotis from a 2/1 into a repeatable engine; none of the pump matters if he cannot connect.

Attack the player whose deck you want to cast from, not just the lowest life total. Kotis exiles from THEIR library, so hitting the combo or control deck produces tutors, countermagic, and extra turns, while creature-heavy decks offer less utility.

Berserk, Might of the Nephilim, and Tainted Strike are your primary finishers. Doubling a pumped Kotis produces 16-24 power, easily one-shotting opponents via commander damage while exiling a quarter of their deck for free casts.
Do not overcommit pump spells before blockers are declared or protection is held up. A single instant-speed exile or bounce spell can blow out combat if you commit before their priority passes.
